title: Gestational diabetes screening in asymptomatic pregnant persons at 24 weeks of gestation or after

source.quote: The USPSTF recommends screening for gestational diabetes in asymptomatic pregnant persons at 24 weeks of gestation or after.

uncomputable.needs: gestational age (at or after 24 weeks of gestation)

all.quote: at 24 weeks of gestation or after

uncomputable.needs: clinician assessment that the patient is asymptomatic for diabetes

denominator.quote: asymptomatic pregnant persons at 24 weeks of gestation or after

derived.window: text ties screening to the current pregnancy at >=24 weeks, not a calendar interval; measurement year used as a proxy for the pregnancy period

numerator.note: Screening should occur during the current pregnancy at or after 24 weeks of gestation; engine cannot verify timing relative to gestational age.
